description: This source file provides utility functions for handling TypeScript files, path resolutions, and runtime checks within a project that involves TypeScript code analysis, testing, and file management.

methods.name: getTypeScript
methods.description: Lazily loads and caches the 'typescript' module.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves and returns the root directory of the repository based on the import meta URL.

methods.name: resolveSourceRoots
methods.description: Converts relative source root paths into absolute paths based on the repository root.

methods.name: isTestLikeTypeScriptFile
methods.description: Determines if a given filename matches known test or test utility suffixes.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects TypeScript files from a target path, optionally including or excluding test files.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFilesFromRoots
methods.description: Aggregates TypeScript files from multiple source root directories.

methods.name: collectFileViolations
methods.description: Reads files and applies a violation-finding function to collect code violations.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Returns the 1-based line number for a node in the source file.

methods.name: getPropertyNameText
methods.description: Extracts the text of a property name if it is an identifier or literal.

methods.name: unwrapExpression
methods.description: Removes parenthesizers and type assertions from an expression to get its core.

methods.name: collectCallExpressionLines
methods.description: Walks through a source file AST to collect line numbers of call expressions.

methods.name: isDirectExecution
methods.description: Checks if the current script is being run directly rather than imported.

methods.name: runAsScript
methods.description: Executes a main function if the script is run directly, catching and logging errors.
